coach.needAnalysis: The coach only explains what the engine found, so the game needs an analysis before a report can be written.
coach.none: The coach reads the engine’s critical moments and explains them in plain language. It does not evaluate positions itself.
coach.waiting: This usually takes under two minutes. You can keep browsing; the report appears here.
coach.timeout: No answer arrived in time. A late answer is still accepted for an hour; you can also try again.
coach.unverified: Unverified move: the engine data does not contain it
coach.flagged: These moves were not in the engine data and are highlighted in the text: {moves}. Treat them with caution.
coach.askPlaceholder: Ask the coach about this game…
coach.disclaimer: The coach explains but does not replace a human trainer; its strategic explanations can be wrong (the moves are checked). Coach usage counts toward your subscription limits.

setup.title: Set up Chess Insight
setup.intro: Three short steps, about five minutes: your public chess.com account, the engine, and your first game.
setup.usernameIntro: Only your public games are read, through the public chess.com API. Nothing else is sent anywhere.
setup.accountOkText: {count, plural, one {# monthly archive was found.} other {# monthly archives were found.}}
setup.operatorHttp: If the network is blocked, an operator must allow the chess.com API for this plugin in Timon’s configuration (check the README for the exact entry). Example:
setup.engineIntro: Stockfish runs locally inside the plugin; no installation is needed. Check that it starts.
setup.engineHelp: The engine ships inside the plugin package. Reinstall the plugin, or ask the operator to check the logs; then check again.
setup.syncIntro: Download your most recent games (the last 15 games), then analyse the latest one.
setup.gamesFound: {count, plural, one {# game downloaded.} other {# games downloaded.}}
setup.noGames: No game was found for this account in the last months.
setup.clearGamesConfirm: Delete all your downloaded games and their analyses? This cannot be undone.
setup.privacy: Only api.chess.com is contacted. Games are stored locally in the plugin database.
